subject: general
question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/effb85f2ff2a3edd9b1c02d567d6fd4a913e223ee150ee491c9afd9788de5604.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In each step, all three symbols move one position clockwise along the border of the square and flip vertically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/258c1902b777e11ccf8f21168bea7dd0b0c05748e07fde284b840e37124495e7.png] 

So in the next figure:

Barred Arrow moves to Top-Left and points downward.

T-shape moves to Bottom-Center and becomes inverted (⊥).

Simple Arrow moves to Bottom-Right and points upward.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
